limitations: New typed APIs are not native object/vtable ABI replacements.
Controlled native differential owners share one actual atomic04 count; physical event/node destructors are not executed in this probe.
Stop native probe uses a published manager layout adapter pointing to the same actual Win32 lock; getter construction/registration belongs to primary actual application-chain validation.
Original append probe uses reserved capacity; complete growth is delegated to existing recovered implementation.
Native terminal actions throwing through virtual00 and native EH dispatcher execution are outside the existing nonthrowing canonical terminal contract.
Captured native spans and owners require valid application lifetimes; no defensive retain/rollback or success fallback was introduced.
